Begin conversations with an easy topic. Talk about
the weather or hobbies. For example, say, “The
weather is so nice today, isn’t it?” Then the other
person can answer easily. Small talk can lead to
(A)[another / other] fun topics to talk about.
Don’t just sit still and listen. (B)[Active / Actively]
listen. Make eye contact with the speaker. Nod your
head from time to time. You can also say, “Right,”
or “I see.” These things will show (C)[what / that]
you’re really listening.

윗글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법상 알맞은 말로바르게 연결된 것은?

(B)
(C)
solution: (A) 뒤에 복수명사구 fun topics를 수식해야 하므로 ‘다른’이라 는 뜻으로 복수명사구 앞에 쓰이는 other가 적절하다. another 는 단수명사(구) 앞에 쓰인다. (B) 동사 listen을 수식해야 하며 동사를 수식하는 것은 형용사 가 아니라 부사이므로 부사 Actively가 적절하다.
